description: MiG-17 monument at the Maospati market, maintained by Lanud Iswahjudi. Serial not published.

Ex-AURI Tu-16KS Badger preserved at Maospati beside Lanud Iswahjudi; open daily 08:00-18:00 per detikJatim. One of only two Tu-16 airframes surviving in Indonesia, the other being M-1625 at the air force museum in Yogyakarta.
